text.description_html:
First Impressions SD-SR6012SMTSS4BSS, 12" Satin Stainless Steel Sutter Ruler Shower Pull

The Sutter Satin Stainless Steel Glass Door Pull comes packaged with everything you'll need to install it on a 1/4 inch to 1/2 inch thick glass door. It comes packaged as a pair of 2 stainless steel handles. Made out of 304 solid stainless steel with a brushed finish, the Sutter Shower Door Pull is great for use in the high-humidity environment of bathrooms as a shower door pull set; however, it can also be installed on any glass door including storefronts. The pull is 12 inches long with 8 inch mounting centers.

Also available matching Sutter Rectangular Stainless Steel Door Pull

Specifications for the First Impressions Sutter Series 6 Glass Door Handle:

  • Pull Material: 304 Solid Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Total Length: 12"
  • Center to Center: 8"
  • Pull Handle Face Width: 1-1/4"
  • Thickness: 3/8"
  • Total Projection: 1.88"
  • Pull Clearance: 1-1/2"
  • Door Mounting: 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass doors.
  • First Impressions SR6012SMTSS4BSS Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Packaged with 2 door pulls and mounting hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass doors.
